title: React Hooks: useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo
description: Understand and master the core React Hooks to manage state, side effects, references, and performance optimization in functional components.

lessons.title: Introduction to Hooks
lessons.content: Hooks allow you to use state and other React features in functional components, introduced in React 16.8 to replace class-based patterns.

lessons.title: useState: Managing Local State
useEffect: Handling Side Effects
useRef: Accessing DOM and Storing Values
useMemo: Optimizing Expensive Calculations
useState with Objects and Arrays
Cleanup with useEffect
Combining useState and useEffect
When and Why to use useMemo
lessons.content: useMemo avoids recalculating values unnecessarily. It's useful for expensive computations or preventing unnecessary re-renders.

lessons.title: Summary: Choosing the Right Hook
lessons.content:
- useState: Local state
- useEffect: Side effects
- useRef: Persistent reference
- useMemo: Performance optimization
Understand the right tool for the right job in functional components.
